config.prompt: Locate every adult butterfly and moth in the image, including small moths. Do not include caterpillars, pupae, other insects, flowers or leaves. Return only a JSON array of boxes: [[x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max], ...]. Coordinates must be integers from 0 to 1000, relative to the whole image. Use tight bounding boxes covering the entire visible insect. Return [] if none are present. No labels or explanations.

timing: RGB image ready -> preprocessing + model + postprocessing + device synchronization; excludes download and model loading
truncated_response_policy: At a verified max_new_tokens limit, retain only complete JSON array items and mark status=truncated. Preserve duplicate boxes and the full raw answer.
note: All baseline attempts, including explicitly marked inference errors retained for retry provenance.
